record.provider: xAI Files API (Grok) + public CDN URLs

free_tier.stated: No published total-storage quota. Per-file 512 MB (some pages say 50 MB for the upload reference and 50 MiB for public URLs). Files are PERMANENT by default. `expires_after` is opt-in.

retention.stated: Per-file 512 MB (some pages say 50 MB for the upload reference and 50 MiB for public URLs). Files are PERMANENT by default. `expires_after` is opt-in.

egress.terms: Every file can mint a public URL on files-cdn.x.ai, Cloudflare-fronted, no API key needed to fetch, no egress charge documented. URL is permanent if the file has no expiry and no expires_after is passed.

record.interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible REST at https://api.x.ai/v1/files. POST upload, GET list, GET {id}, GET {id}/content (streams raw bytes, Content-Type application/octet-stream), DELETE, plus POST {id}/public-url and /public-url/revoke.
record.tooling: openai-python with base_url swapped to https://api.x.ai/v1; xai_sdk; curl
record.chaining: Upload workflow generates public URLs cached at CDN edge locations. Files maintain one active public URL at a time, and repeated requests return the existing public link idempotently.
record.limits_note: Per-object-cap 512 MB (50 MB if you want a public URL. Public URLs are limited to images/video mime types). 'A file can have at most one active public URL at a time.' Public-URL creation can fail if the team hits its active-URL quota.
record.reliability_note: The absence of a published total quota is the finding, not an oversight. A third-party comparison site says outright 'no storage limit is stated. xAI says only that limits may vary slightly by platform or subscription'. Treat unverified. Files persist 'until you delete them'. Collections is a separate product with a 100 MB/file cap and requires credits in the account. Public URLs only cover image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/webp, video/mp4, video/webm. So the CDN path is media-only; arbitrary blobs must go through the authenticated content endpoint.

evidence.proved: 'Files default to permanent storage until you delete them'; expires_after range 3600–2592000; 'Stream the raw bytes'; 'The endpoint streams the response, so it works for files of any supported size'

'Every file you upload through the Files API lives in private storage by default … Public URLs turn a stored file into a permanent, shareable link on the SpaceXSI CDN that anyone can open — no API key required'; 'File has no expiration, expires_after omitted — URL never expires'; limitations: max 50 MiB, restricted content types
'Maximum file size: 100MB'; 'you must have credits in your account'
'no storage limit is stated' for xAI

The rate card reads 'grok-4.7 $2.00' in and '$6.00' out per million tokens, and the only free thing the site offers is the Playground: 'Try Grok free in the Playground'. The USD 150 a month data-sharing credit that every credit list carries is not on the current documentation index.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: if the data-sharing credit returns, it is the largest recurring inference allowance among documented hosts: USD 150 a month / USD 2.00 per million input tokens = 75 million grok-4.7 input tokens a month, or 25 million output tokens at USD 6.00.

limits.value: there is no allowance to exhaust: a prepaid balance or a card is required before the first call, and the rate table is the only limit.

record.notes: This is the most-repeated number in this category and the evidence is in conflict, so the rung is inferred from three observations: the live docs index has no free-credit page, the API landing page offers only the Playground, and a 2026 write-up states the programme is gone. Against that, a documentation mirror still carries the full text of the programme. If it is live, the gate is worse than it looks: the team must spend USD 5 before opting in, opting in cannot be reversed, and teams in the United Kingdom and most of the European Union are excluded by country. Unverified: one USD 5 prepayment and a look at the Credits section of console.x.ai. Scope note: documented records already holds storage/xai-files-api-public-cdn-urls, which covers xAI file storage and public CDN URLs; it says nothing about inference credit, and this record does not touch storage.
